paragraphs.text: Time is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who on the card Temple of Atropos .

Time is a planet that existed outside of time and space. It is artificial, created as part of the Time Lords ' efforts to end the Dark Times and keep the forces of time under control . Its planetary mass was carefully calculated for its purpose and it contains the Temple of Atropos, home of the Mouri who control the flow of time.
